summary: Race condition in pause/unpause workflow execution: when PauseWorkflowExecution is called while a workflow task is in-flight, the server creates an inconsistent state where the workflow Status is reset to RUNNING but PauseInfo remains set, causing unpause to fail.
userImpact: Users cannot unpause workflows that were paused while a task was in-flight, leaving workflows stuck in an inconsistent state unable to recover.
rootCause: When PauseWorkflowExecution is called during an in-flight workflow task, the WorkflowTaskStamp invalidation does not prevent the already-received task from completing. The RespondWorkflowTaskCompleted triggers a new workflow task scheduling that resets Status to RUNNING without clearing PauseInfo.
proposedFix: Fix the pause status check in UpdateWorkflowWithNew to prevent workflow task scheduling when paused; ensure WorkflowTaskStamp invalidation prevents in-flight task completion; ensure any status reset also clears PauseInfo.
keyQuote: If in-flight at pause-time, the completing task triggers new scheduling that resets Status to RUNNING while leaving pauseInfo set, making unpause fail with FailedPrecondition.
